alejandra (CSE): FYI got a high-severity from AcmeCorp — embeddings+rerank results are returning low-quality top results and overall latency spikes on rerank path. Customer says search relevance dropped after last model roll.
sam (sales): Oof — they’re on Dedicated, $120k ARR. Pointed out regression after we shipped the default embedding model update last week. They want a mitigation and timeline.
eva (PM): Can you paste repro steps and a couple of failing examples? Need to triage: product bug vs config change vs model quality.
alejandra (CSE): Repro steps from customer:
- query ids: "how do I reset my device" + several real user queries
- pipeline: candidate generation via ANN (FAISS ivf_flat) -> embeddings from redwood-embed-v2 -> rerank with dot-product similarity
They attached a small CSV with 25 queries and expected doc IDs. Quick sample inlined: "query: how to factory reset model: redwood-embed-v2 candidates: 50 rerank top1: doc_72 expected: doc_12"
tom (engr-search): Noted: last week’s embed model changed vector norm distribution. If reranker uses raw dot-product, normalization shift can reorder scores. Two quick checks: 1) compare cosine vs dot on their vectors 2) verify candidate pool size and index config. Also latency: rerank is done on CPU right now with full scoring of 50 candidates — that explains spikes.
michael (data): I ran their CSV locally with both v1 and v2 embeddings. Observed mean cosine similarity delta of ~0.12 that flips top-3 in 8/25 queries. Will upload numbers shortly.
eva (PM): OK. Proposed priority: P1 for mitigation (customer facing) + P2 for product fix. Mitigation timeline target: hotfix within 48h, full product fix in next sprint. Acceptance criteria for hotfix:
- Provide config toggle to revert to previous embedding model for that tenant OR apply vector normalization before rerank
- Demonstrate restored top-1 accuracy on their sample set (>=90% of baseline)
- Latency for rerank not increasing >10% vs current baseline
- Rollout plan and communication note for customer
sam (sales): They’ll accept a tenant-scoped rollback. If we can give them a temporary switch and ETA, they'll be happy. Please scope effort.
tom (engr-search): Hotfix options ranked:
1) Tenant-level model pin to redwood-embed-v1 — fastest (config + small API change).
2) Normalize vectors at rerank layer (L2 normalize embeddings before dot) — small change but must check CPU overhead.
3) Switch rerank scoring to cosine by default — safer but requires testing across workloads.
I estimate option 1 is ~4 engineer-hours, option 2 ~1 day including perf tests, option 3 ~2-3 days with CI.
alejandra (CSE): Customer prefers option 1 now. Can we do it as a config flag in Dedicated control plane?
eva (PM): Yes. Story for product backlog (flat fields below):
- id: CS-emb-rerank-176345
- summary: Tenant-scoped embedding model rollback & rerank normalization
- problem: Embedding model update changed vector distribution causing rerank regressions for some workloads; also CPU latency regressions when normalizing in rerank path.
- acceptance_criteria: "1) Tenant can pin embedding model version via control plane; 2) Toggle to apply L2 normalization at rerank layer; 3) Automated regression test with customer sample dataset; 4) Metrics dashboard showing relevance delta and rerank latency during rollout"
- rollout_criteria: "Canary to 1 tenant -> 24h monitoring -> ramp to all affected tenants if no regressions"
- estimated_effort: "1 PM + 1 Eng (search) 3 days for backlog item to prod with canary"
(keep this as a short note, will copy into JIRA)
sam (sales): Add to notes: impact = potential churn risk. Customer may pause integrations without quick fix.
tom (engr-search): Quick repro command to fetch embeddings and simulate rerank:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":["how to factory reset"]}'
# then do dot vs cosine on returned vectors in python
```
support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-348. Assigned to eng-search. Priority: High.
michael (data): Uploaded CSV + result diffs to the shared folder: /shared/acmecorp-emb-rerank-diffs.csv
alejandra (CSE): I'll send customer the tenant-rollback option + ETA 48h, and include temporary workaround: increase candidate pool to 200 to reduce false negatives and apply keyword hybrid (BM25) scoring.
eva (PM): Next steps for product backlog: create JIRA CS-emb-rerank-176345, attach repro + metrics, set spike to investigate normalization vs model-pin tradeoffs. Tentative sprint: next week. I'll post the JIRA link when created.
sam (sales): Thanks team. Please @sam (sales) on any doc for customer comms.
